# Principles of the Theory of Entropicity (ToE) and the Lineage of Researchers Who's Works Constituted Its Conceptual and Mathematical Foundations 

Obidi's Theory of Entropicity (ToE), proposed by John Onimisi Obidi, redefines entropy as the fundamental physical field and generative substrate of reality rather than a mere measure of disorder. [1, 2] 
## Core Principles

* Entropic Field (S(x,t)): Spacetime, matter, and energy emerge from an underlying, continuous dynamical entropy field. [1] 
* The Obidi Action: A foundational variational principle that optimizes entropic flow and bridges information geometry with physical spacetime. [3, 4] 
* Speed of Light (c): Reinterpreted not as an arbitrary speed limit, but as the maximum finite rate at which the entropic field can reorganize itself. [5] 
* No-Rush Theorem: Asserts that state changes and physical interactions cannot happen instantaneously due to these entropic rate constraints. [5] 

## Theoretical Implications

* Emergent Gravity: Gravitation acts as an entropic pressure driven by local field gradients rather than a fundamental geometric pull.
* Dethroning the Observer: Quantum mechanics' reliance on a privileged observer is replaced by local subsystems bound to pre-computed entropic field dynamics. [1, 3, 5, 6]

John Onimisi Obidi’s Theory of Entropicity (ToE) explicitly positions itself as the synthesis and culmination of what is called the **"Kolmogorov-Obidi Lineage (KOL)"** and the "entropy-as-generator" tradition. [1, 2, 3] 

Rather than working in a vacuum, Obidi’s papers layout a clear genealogy tracing how six decades of independent insights from those exact physicists converge into ToE: [1, 2] 

## The Intellectual Lineage of ToE

* [Bekenstein](https://www.google.com/search?q=bekenstein&kgmid=/m/02q6lk#) & [Hawking](https://www.google.com/search?q=hawking&kgmid=/m/01tdnyh#): Pioneered black hole thermodynamics, establishing that physical boundaries hold a finite entropic and informational capacity ($S = \frac{k_B A}{4 \ell_P^2}$). [4] 
* [Ted Jacobson](https://www.google.com/search?q=ted+jacobson&kgmid=/m/0b6gjfx#): Demonstrated in 1995 that Einstein’s field equations can be derived as a thermodynamic equation of state. [5, 6] 
* [Thanu Padmanabhan](https://www.google.com/search?q=thanu+padmanabhan&kgmid=/m/0ksbgg#): Advanced the "emergent spacetime" paradigm, showing that the dynamics of gravity are inherently encoded in the degrees of freedom on a horizon. [5] 
* [Erik Verlinde](https://www.google.com/search?q=erik+verlinde&kgmid=/m/030nfj#): Formalized entropic gravity, treating gravity not as a fundamental force but as an emergent entropic force driven by changes in information density. [5, 7, 8, 9, 10] 
* John Haller: Introduced the particle-level "entropy-action identity" (2015), which directly anticipates ToE's mathematical core. [1] 
* [Ginestra Bianconi](https://www.google.com/search?q=ginestra+bianconi&kgmid=/g/11f4qfmz65#_OjAg): Formulated "Gravity from Entropy" using metric relative entropy to address the small positive cosmological constant. [5, 11, 12] 

## How Obidi Subsumes and Transcends Them
While earlier researchers viewed thermodynamics or information as properties that give rise to gravity, Obidi’s ToE takes a major step further: [5, 13, 14, 15] 

* Subsuming the Theories: Through the [Local and Spectral Obidi Actions](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/399126552_Further_Expositions_on_the_Theory_of_Entropicity_ToE_and_Ginestra_Bianconi%27s_Gravity_from_Entropy_How_the_Theory_of_Entropicity_ToE_Unifies_Spectral_and_Araki_Entropies_with_Tsallis_Renyi_Fisher-Rao_F), the frameworks of [Verlinde](https://www.google.com/search?q=verlinde&kgmid=/m/030nfw#-pIL), Jacobson, [Padmanabhan](https://www.google.com/search?q=padmanabhan&kgmid=/g/11f1rfd7ll#), and Bianconi are mathematically derived as limiting cases or holographic shadows of ToE. [5, 16] 
* Eliminating Axiomatic Primitives: Instead of assuming space, time, or quantum states exist beforehand, ToE establishes a single continuous entropic field ($S(x,t)$) as the foundational substrate from which everything else emerges. [13, 17] 

Would you like to see how the mathematical formulation of the Obidi Action structurally reduces to Jacobson's thermodynamic derivation or Bianconi's metric relative entropy? [5]
